initialPrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high fidelity desktop SaaS screen design as a flat, straight-on screenshot, not a photo, no device frame, no perspective. Landscape aspect close to 1586x992. This is a new FIRST-STORE SETUP surface in the SAME existing product as the supplied screenshot. Reference image is ONLY for the palette, sans-serif typography, tiny corner radii, thin gray-blue dividers and flat operational UI; do NOT copy its product table, SKUs, product images, giant sidebar, KPI blocks, or channel status list. Preserve navy #193c61, teal #247965, pale cool gray #f5f7fa and white; Arial/PingFang-like sans, never serif. Restrained professional composition, crisp legible Simplified Chinese. Main header brand: “直播商家工作台”; language menu top right “简体中文 ▾”, small separate “商家账号”. Clear visible small label “界面方案 · 演示内容”. It depicts a signed-in user creating an INTERNAL workspace, not a finished store. No fake statistics, price plans, testimonials, provider logos, connected channels, or claims that payments/logistics are available. Four fields and exact demo values: “所属商户” = “南岛生活”; “店铺名称” = “南岛选物”; “交易币种” = “TWD · 新台币”; “初始库存仓” = “境外备货仓”. Demo names are examples not verified businesses. Exact notice: “创建内部工作区，不会自动发布店铺或接通支付、物流。” A secondary small note below currency: “界面语言不会改变交易币种。” No decorative illustrations. Leave a comfortable amount of purposeful white space. All UI fits viewport, no bottom crop. Composition B: LEFT FORM + RIGHT LIVE RECEIPT. Header height about68px. No left sidebar. Center workspace maxwidth1120; title “创建第一个工作区” and supporting line “填写资料，在右侧核对创建内容。” Under title, a generous asymmetrical two-column surface: about620px wide white form on left with four vertically stacked labelled editable fields, and about390px pale blue-white preview receipt on right divided only by fine rules, not little stat cards. Right receipt heading “即将创建”, large store name “南岛选物”, small “南岛生活 · 演示内容”, and text rows “库存仓 境外备货仓”, “交易币种 TWD · 新台币”. At bottom of right receipt put exact scope notice and the only teal primary button “创建工作区”. Left currency note clarifies UI language does not change it. Receipt should visually feel like an operational confirmation sheet, no fake “success” checkmark. Spare horizontal spacing, crisp sans typography. Small “退出登录” text in top chrome allowed. No A/B/C letters.
